LanguageData.MM_ReaverStatusTip:
Recharges automatically from the light network. Stores up to 10000 light.
Piloted idle: 1 light/s; moving: 3 light/s; caravan travel: 1200 light/day.
Stores 8 missiles. Makes one every 5 seconds for 150 light and stops when full. Disable fabrication to save energy.
Restores 25 shield points for 250 light. Carries 2000 kg; caravan speed: 4 world tiles/day.
LanguageData.MM_ReaverAttackDesc: Fire one stored missile per second. Damage: 16; armor penetration: 75%; blast radius: 4 cells. Deals triple damage to buildings and can hit allies. Range: 45 cells; minimum: 4.5. Requires a pilot, power and ammunition. Firing costs no extra light; movement suspends fire.
LanguageData.MM_ReaverLoadDesc: Choose cargo, then a colonist to load it. Capacity: 2000 kg.
LanguageData.MM_ReaverMoveDesc: Move at a base speed of 4 cells/s, affected by terrain. Firing stops while moving.
LanguageData.MM_ReaverTeleportDesc: Teleport with the pilot and cargo and ammunition to clear ground covered by the light network on the same map. Uses 300 network traffic. Cooldown: about 16.7 seconds.
LanguageData.MM_ReaverFabricateDesc: Make one missile every 5 seconds, paying 150 light on completion, up to 8 stored missiles. Stops when full. Low energy or disabling this option pauses progress without losing it. Works without a pilot and during caravan travel.
